---
title: "2. Preview the results: Your own study"
---

## Your task

Before running your study, identify the three outputs you will inspect. No figures are shown here because you have not supplied or analysed your own inputs yet.

## Composition

After the run, open `results/my-study/figures/composition.png`.

Identify the displayed features with different proportions across samples. Check the full relative-abundance table before explaining Other.

## Shannon diversity

After the run, open `results/my-study/figures/shannon-diversity.png`.

Compare group medians, spread, and overlap. Check observed feature counts and evenness before explaining a difference.

## Count totals and diversity

After the run, open `results/my-study/figures/depth-diversity.png`.

Record count ranges and investigate unusually low totals. Consider whether the pattern changes among samples with similar totals.

::: {.callout-note}
These are descriptive plots. Composition bars sum to 100%; they do not show count totals. Visual differences alone do not establish statistical significance or causation.
:::
